findings.claim: Per Earnings Whispers on FQ4 report (single secondary source): FY27 growth raised to mid-to-upper teens, A&D and Industrial each expected >20% growth, new 6.5–7.0% operating margin goal. Unverified against company release.
EMS industry demand strong; capacity and lead time, not demand, are primary constraint (Global Electronics Association, June 2026 N.A. EMS results, book-to-bill 1.33, shipments +6.7%).
European EMS: defence expected to remain strongest structural growth driver; consolidation accelerating.
Lincoln International Q2 2026 EMS review: A&D, data center/AI, critical power remained areas of strength; margins vary more with mix, execution, utilization than size.
findings.source: Lincoln International EMS Quarterly Review Q2 2026
